module_summary: The dialog layer of the menu ELF. dia.cpp lays out and draws a UIItem array (labels, buttons, int/bool/enum/string/colour rows), handles focus navigation, scrolling, right-stick peek, Settings peer-page L1/R1 results and list keys, and runs the modal loop diaExecuteDialog under the GUI lock. diaeditors.cpp holds the modal value editors (on-screen keyboard, number pad, colour picker); diaitems.cpp the get/set accessors by item id; dialogs.h the shared item-id enum and the extern dialog definitions (defined in src/ui/dialogs.cpp). cfgtitle.cpp is the opt-in per-source cache of CFG Title strings used for game-row display and sorting, filled on the IO thread and swapped under the GUI lock.

findings.title: diaShowKeyb writes one byte past its pre[maxLen] VLA when strlen(text) == maxLen; File Manager rename passes FM_NAME - 1 with names up to 127 bytes
findings.problem: diaKeybTextWidth copies text[from..to) into scratch and writes scratch[to - from] = 0; diaShowKeyb passes the stack VLA pre[maxLen] with from=view(0) and to=n=len every frame, so len == maxLen writes pre[maxLen]. fmRenameEntry seeds name from a list entry (fmList keeps names up to 127 bytes, filemgr.cpp:208-210) and passes maxLen FM_NAME - 1 = 127, so renaming a file whose name is 127 bytes long overwrites one stack byte per frame while the keyboard is open. Every other caller passes the buffer size.
findings.fix: Pass sizeof(name) (FM_NAME) instead of FM_NAME - 1 at guifilemgr.cpp:523 and :539, matching every other diaShowKeyb caller and fmNameOk's 1..FM_NAME-1 limit (filemgr.cpp:151).
findings.benefit: Closes a reachable one-byte stack overwrite in the main thread (consequence depends on what lies above the VLA in the frame: INFERRED); no size change.
findings.evidence: Read diaeditors.cpp:104-109 (memcpy + scratch[to-from]=0), :130 len=strlen(text), :138 caret=len, :215 char pre[maxLen], :216 n=len, :224 and :238 diaKeybTextWidth(shown, view, n, pre). Callers (grep diaShowKeyb): dia.cpp:946 tmp[32]/32, gui.cpp:176 tmp[maxLength]/maxLength, menusys.cpp:2252 empty/CONFIG_KEY_VALUE_LEN, guigame.cpp:110/153 handler args from dia.cpp:941 (tmp,32), guifilemgr.cpp:523/539 name[FM_NAME]/FM_NAME-1. FM_NAME 128 at include/filemgr.h:8; fmList keeps strlen < 128 (filemgr.cpp:208-210); rename reached from diaFileActions FMA_RENAME (guifilemgr.cpp:602-603).

findings.title: On-screen keyboard moves the caret and backspaces one byte at a time, splitting multi-byte UTF-8 in an existing name
findings.problem: L1/R1 do caret-- / caret++ and both backspaces memmove out exactly one byte, while the view scroll already steps by UTF-8 characters (diaKeybNextChar/PrevChar). Renaming a game (menusys.cpp:306-316) or file whose name holds multi-byte UTF-8 leaves orphan lead/continuation bytes after one backspace, or inserts a key inside a sequence; confirming writes that invalid name through gsOf()->rename.
findings.fix: Use the existing helpers: caret = diaKeybPrevChar(text, caret) / diaKeybNextChar(text, caret, len) for L1/R1, and make both backspaces remove the bytes from diaKeybPrevChar(text, caret) to caret. ASCII text behaves exactly as now.
findings.benefit: Prevents renames that write broken UTF-8 into game/file names; no new code, four expressions change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read diaeditors.cpp:298-307, 351-367, 395-403 (byte steps) and 112-126 (UTF-8-aware helpers used only for view at :225-227). Callers seeding existing names: menusys.cpp:306-309 (game rename via guiShowKeyboard), guifilemgr.cpp:522-523. INFERRED part: which devices return UTF-8 names; BDM FatFs is built with FF_LFN_UNICODE 0 / FF_CODE_PAGE 869 (modules/bdm/bdmfs_fatfs/fatfs/include/ffconf.h:87,136), so the case needs a source such as SMB/NFS/HDD returning UTF-8.

findings.title: Cancel on a focused int/bool/enum row restores the value the page opened with, discarding an earlier confirmed edit of the same row
findings.problem: diaHandleInput's Cancel calls diaResetValue, which sets current = def; def is the value diaSetInt stored when the page opened (diaitems.cpp:105-106) and edits never update it. Sequence: set an IP octet 192 -> 10 and confirm, focus it again, press Up once, press Cancel: the row shows 192, not 10. Same for enums. Inherited Open PS2 Loader behaviour.
findings.fix: When Confirm gives a row focus (dia.cpp:1298-1301) remember cur->intvalue.current in a local, and on Cancel restore that value for UI_INT/UI_BOOL/UI_ENUM instead of def; def stays the page-open value diaHasChanges needs.
findings.justification: Adds one local and one assignment: def cannot be reused because diaHasChanges (diaitems.cpp:59-80) depends on it meaning the page-open value, so the pre-edit value has to be kept somewhere; this is the smallest place.
findings.benefit: Cancel undoes only the current edit; about 3 lines added (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read dia.cpp:839-855 (diaResetValue uses def), :863-868 (Cancel path), :1298-1301 (focus taken), :919-934 (Up/Down change current only); diaitems.cpp:97-111 (diaSetInt sets def and current) and :55-80 (diaHasChanges compares to def, comment says Cancel restores def).
